# AI Trust Commons

> Nikhil Singhal's AI governance work. The home page shows AI governance in practice. Nine steps follow one sales contract as AI agents hand work between teams and companies. A gate checks the rules at each handoff.

Writing is licensed CC BY 4.0. Credit Nikhil Singhal.

## Main pages

- [AI governance in practice, plain text](https://aitrustcommons.org/ai-governance-in-practice.md): the home page's words without the design
- [About Nikhil Singhal](https://aitrustcommons.org/about/): who he is and his published work
- [From Instinct to Intent™](https://aitrustcommons.org/blog/): his posts on the gap between human intent and machine execution
